comment: The case matrix of the soft-takeoff recette. runner: script = deterministic command that decides; agent = a cheap-model walkthrough that must return evidence; owner = a person (real money, real machines, a decision). status: ready | to-verify (a fact to confirm before the first run) | needs-build (something must exist first) | blocked (waits for an owner decision or a paid resource). Evidence never goes in git. light: true = part of the first, cheap wave. watch: the in-flight work whose delivery should make this case run again (cloud-budget = the session on Cloud budget and billing, slides = the session on slide creation and editing). expect: a canary, the verdict it must get. timeout: seconds, for a long case.

cases.title: Auto Routing picks from the person's list; the fallback never loops
The Kybernos model fails (503, 429, 401, one failure): a plain card tells the person what happened, and the chat stays usable
cases.note: Turned into a script on 2026-11-03 (scripts/check-model-failures-live.mjs): the replica's control port makes the stand-in provider fail, the script reads the sentence on the page and prints it. The script decides the mechanical part (something is said, no raw JSON/undefined/stack, composer still there, next turn answers); whether the sentence tells the person the right thing is for the owner to read (every sentence is printed). The own-key half (a wrong key on a real provider, a 429 or a timeout on an own key) is not covered: no stand-in provider answers those (README § 8 item 11). Red on its first run (the person read the server's raw JSON, T-021), green since the plain card; the engine's own red row keeps the raw body.

Record the sentence in the composer, the buttons, and where each leads (top up, upgrade). Put the stand-in back to {"completion":1}.
cases.note: To confirm before the first run: the size of welcome_credit_cents on the replica (owner setting), and that a fresh test account can be made without re-running `up` (it re-clones both sandboxes). The check points the sandbox at its own stand-in relay through `servers.json`; a sandbox started with the replica's address (the recette default of `soft-takeoff-sandbox-up.sh`), or one that is paired with the replica (A, B), sends the stand-in's token to the replica, which refuses it: « Sign in needed », no « Add a phone » button, 14 reds.
